description: Ministry of Justice - Order empower the Judge of the High Court Sitting in the Judicial Zone at Hambantota to exercise Admiralty Jurisdiction
categorisation: This gazette content involves the Minister of Justice exercising powers under the Judicature Act to empower a High Court Judge in Hambantota to exercise Admiralty jurisdiction. This falls under judicial matters and law enforcement regulations, specifically concerning court jurisdiction and judicial powers, making it a Judicial/Law Enforcement Gazette (Type 9). While it mentions a minister's name, it does not focus on government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities (which would be Types 2 or 3), but rather on judicial authority and jurisdiction.
